annotationMethod: All188 chosen display-order frames were visually inspected at quarter-resolution in source-only sheets; source180..199 inspected for trim boundary. Thirteen initial full-resolution source frames0,25,35,40,50,75,100,125,150,160,170,174,179 were viewed for joint neighborhoods. Independent AI reviewer separately checked sides/occlusion and full187. Manual visual construction handles below form conservative boxes by taking the union of adjacent handles plus margins. This is an envelope, not point tracking or model interpolation. Every chosen frame was inspected for envelope suitability. Cuff/hand/hair-hidden or cropped centres are null/unknown even when a local context box exists. Shoulders are broadly bounded through visible upper-arm/torso clothing contours, not exact cloth seams. No physical gate was calculated before these manual regions were fixed.
